note: Subject layer of direction B (Rust-red rags and canvas) of the Goblin redesign study, bead pulp_wars-wrn.1. Exploration only; see docs/art/factions/GOBLIN_REDESIGN.md.

subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER: Subject: Goblin, a chunky cute scrappy little goblin raider with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body leaning forward, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, with lighter #cbd85a on the face, nose and belly and darker #7f8f22 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes with black pupils and a wide toothy grin, a rust-red bandana, colour #b8452a, with two knot tails, a bare chest with one rust-red strap, a short rust-red rag loincloth, light canvas wraps round the forearms, a dark brown belt, an oversized jagged grey iron dagger held up in the right hand, big bare yellow-green feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a sneaky little stabber, not a soldier with a shield.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER: Subject: Wolf Rider, a chunky cute little goblin riding a big shaggy wolf, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: the wolf is mid grey with a cream belly, chest and muzzle, a big head with pointed ears, a long snout with an open grin and small cream fangs, four chunky grey legs and paws; a patched light canvas saddle blanket with a rust-red edge on its back; the goblin rider has yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, shaded #7f8f22, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a rust-red bandana and strap, and waves a short grey iron spear with a rust-red rag tied below the blade; simple shapes and very few details; the wolf's paws are the lowest thing in the image; clearly wolf cavalry, not a horse.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Bomb Chucker, a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, with lighter #cbd85a on the face and darker #7f8f22 shading, huge pointed ears, a big excited grin, a dented grey iron pot helmet with round goggles pushed up on it and a rust-red rag tied round it, a bare chest with two crossed rust-red straps, a rust-red rag loincloth, the right arm raised high holding one big round black bomb above the head with one band of hazard yellow and black stripes, a short fuse and a bright spark, a bulging light canvas satchel on the hip, dark brown boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a bomb thrower, not an archer.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD: Subject: Orc Brute, a chunky cute big broad orc with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a wide heavy body filling the whole width of the image: olive green skin, colour #6e8e30, with lighter #95b052 on the face, jaw, chest and belly and darker #556b22 shading, a heavy jaw with two cream tusks, a flat nose, small grumpy eyes under a heavy brow, the whole face clearly visible, a rust-red bandana, a bare chest with rust-red straps and a patched light canvas kilt, a big round shield of light canvas stretched on a grey iron rim with a rust-red painted stripe held on the left arm, a huge chunky grey iron cleaver in the right hand, dark brown boots, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a big shield bruiser.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Orc Warboss, a chunky cute big bossy orc chief with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a broad stocky body: olive green skin, colour #6e8e30, with lighter #95b052 on the face and chest and darker #556b22 shading, a big face fully visible with a wide open shouting mouth, two cream tusks and angry eyebrows, a small grey iron helmet sitting high on the head with two big curved cream horns and no visor, a short rust-red cape over the shoulders only, a bare chest with rust-red straps and a light canvas kilt, a big dented light grey tin megaphone held out to the side, away from the face, in the right hand, the left fist raised; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a yelling war chief.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin fireworks cart, clearly bigger than a soldier: a roped bundle of five fat paper fireworks rockets on thin sticks standing up in the cart and leaning forward, paper tubes in red, orange, yellow, blue and green, each with a cream paper cone tip, one fuse lit with a bright spark; the cart is a frame of light pale wood with a patched light canvas cover, on two wooden wheels; a little goblin with yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, huge pointed ears and a rust-red bandana leans out of the cart holding a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a home-made fireworks cart, not a catapult.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: a boxy body of bolted grey iron panels with rivets and rust-red painted patches, one small panel with hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes, a patched light canvas roof flap, a big spiked grey iron ram on the front, four mismatched chunky black wheels, a crooked exhaust pipe puffing a round light grey smoke cloud; a little goblin driver with yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a rust-red bandana and round goggles grips a small steering wheel; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a war buggy, not a cart.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Troll, a chunky cute giant mossy troll, a huge hulking hunched lump much wider and taller than a normal soldier: a big round head sunk forward between enormous shoulders, sage green skin, colour #7a9670, with a big pale cream-green #cfdfc4 belly, chest and face and darker #587450 shading on the back and arms, a few light moss tufts on the head and shoulders, a huge drooping nose, tiny eyes and a goofy underbite with two cream tusks, very long arms reaching down to the knees, a huge knobbly light grey stone club resting on the right shoulder, a patched rust-red rag loincloth with light canvas patches, big bare sage green feet, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a friendly giant, not a normal soldier.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER: Subject: Goblin portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute scrappy little goblin raider: a huge round head with yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, lighter #cbd85a on the face and darker #7f8f22 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes and a wide toothy grin, a rust-red bandana with knot tails, bare yellow-green shoulders with a rust-red strap, the tip of a jagged grey iron dagger; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER: Subject: Wolf Rider portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin rider with the big head of his mid grey wolf beside him: yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, shaded #7f8f22, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a rust-red bandana and strap; the wolf has a cream muzzle, pointed ears and small cream fangs; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Bomb Chucker portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower: a huge round head with yellow-green skin, colour #a8bb34, shaded #7f8f22, huge pointed ears, a big excited grin, a dented grey iron pot helmet with a rust-red rag and round goggles, rust-red straps on bare shoulders, one big round black bomb with a band of hazard yellow and black stripes and a bright spark held up beside the head; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:GUARD: Subject: Orc Brute portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big broad orc: a huge round head with olive green skin, colour #6e8e30, lighter #95b052 on the face and jaw, a heavy jaw, two cream tusks, small grumpy eyes, the whole face clearly visible under a rust-red bandana, rust-red straps on bare shoulders, the top of a round light canvas shield on a grey iron rim; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Orc Warboss portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big bossy orc chief: a huge round head with olive green skin, colour #6e8e30, lighter #95b052 on the face, the face fully visible with a wide open shouting mouth, two cream tusks and angry eyebrows, a small grey iron helmet sitting high on the head with two big curved cream horns, a short rust-red cape on the shoulders, a light grey tin megaphone held beside the face; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute home-made goblin fireworks cart shown whole: a roped bundle of fat paper fireworks rockets in red, orange, yellow, blue and green with cream paper cone tips, one fuse lit, on a small rickety cart of light pale wood with a patched light canvas cover and two wooden wheels, a little yellow-green goblin with a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; clearly fireworks, not a missile.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy shown whole, wide and low: a boxy body of grey iron panels with rust-red painted patches and one hazard yellow and black striped panel, a light canvas roof flap, a big spiked iron ram on the front, chunky black wheels, a crooked exhaust pipe with a light grey smoke cloud and a little goblin driver with yellow-green skin, a rust-red bandana and goggles; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Troll portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute giant mossy troll: a big round head with sage green skin, colour #7a9670, a pale cream-green #cfdfc4 face and chest, darker #587450 shading, light moss tufts, a huge drooping nose, tiny eyes and a goofy underbite with two cream tusks, enormous shoulders, the top of a light grey stone club; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:1: Subject: a small level-1 goblin rag camp: three chunky round tents of patched light canvas with rust-red patches and stitched seams, one hut of grey iron sheets with a rust-red painted roof and a bent chimney pipe, and a crooked pale wooden lookout pole with a small basket platform and no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:2: Subject: a level-2 goblin rag camp, clearly bigger than a small camp, with no castle and no stone: big round tents of patched light canvas with rust-red patches, a hut of grey iron sheets with a rust-red roof, a pale wooden lookout tower with a canvas roof and no flag, a chimney pipe with a small light grey smoke cloud, a low spiked fence. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:3: Subject: a large level-3 goblin rag camp, the biggest settlement, with no castle and no stone: one huge tent of patched light canvas with rust-red stripes and a bare pole, small canvas tents, four huts of grey iron sheets with rust-red painted roofs and pale plank doors, three chimney pipes with light grey smoke, a spiked fence. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat seen from the front-right: a lopsided hull of pale weathered planks patched with riveted grey iron plates, one crooked mast with one big patched light canvas sail with rust-red patches, a small barrel on deck and one paper firework rocket tied to the mast, and a little yellow-green goblin with huge pointed ears and a rust-red bandana peeking over the rail; simple shapes and very few details; silly, never grim.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship seen from the front-right: a tall lopsided hull of pale weathered planks and riveted grey iron plates with rust-red painted stripes, an iron lookout tower, two crooked masts with big patched light canvas sails with rust-red patches, barrels on deck and a rack of paper firework rockets, and a little yellow-green goblin with huge pointed ears; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Goblins, a chunky cute wide ramshackle raft seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: pale logs and planks lashed together with rope, patched with grey iron plates, two crooked oars, a heap of cargo and barrels under a patched light canvas tarp, a short pole with a rust-red rag; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat shown whole from the front-right: pale weathered planks patched with grey iron, one big patched light canvas sail with rust-red patches, a little yellow-green goblin with huge pointed ears; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship shown whole from the front-right: pale planks and grey iron plates with rust-red stripes, two patched light canvas sails with rust-red patches, an iron lookout tower and paper firework rockets; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
